items.name: A Special Surprise
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: Here we are. It's a beautiful Saturday night.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: The merger's complete, and after all his hard work, my dear Stratton will have a special surprise waiting for him: me! *excited giggle*

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: Now that everything's done, he has no reason to reject me. And how our love will bloom, like it was always meant to!

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: *calling out* Stratton, dear? Are you home? Stratton?

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: *gasp* No... No, no, no, no! Not breathing... Oh god! *sobbing* You were here all along and I... What happened to you? Did someone...?

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: *viciously* Brutus.

items.name: Stella Meets Stratton
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: You're new here. I know all my regulars. How did you like the show?

transcript.speaker: Stratton
transcript.text: I'm sorry, but that spot's taken.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: I don't see anyone taking it. A shame... Whoever stood you up clearly doesn't see what they're missing.

transcript.speaker: Stratton
transcript.text: They're missing the opportunity of a lifetime. If we don't close this merger, it's- You wouldn't understand.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: Forget the merger, honey. Forget all of it. You're here with me now, isn't that right?

transcript.speaker: Stratton
transcript.text: No, I'm- I can't be distracted by this right now. Security! I need help with this dancer- Wait, wait! No, it's not me! I'm the one being harassed!

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: Now, Brutus, hold on. Don't be so rough with him. Brutus! *sigh* What a dolt. I was just getting interested...

items.name: The Final Scene
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Theatre Tech
transcript.text: And... lights.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: *door slams open* There you are, you big, stupid animal!

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: How could you do this to me? How could you do any of it?! If you truly loved me... you should have backed off!

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: No! Don't come any closer! Don't!

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: *gunshots, followed by a heavy thud, and crying*

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: It was never supposed to be like this... We had love, all of us. Brutus, for me. Me, for Stratton. Stratton... for his job. We all had so much love.

transcript.speaker: Stella
transcript.text: Maybe, after all... It was too much. Maybe... I caused all this...

transcript.speaker: Theatre Tech
transcript.text: Something's wrong. We have to stop the rehearsal.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Oh, for Christ's sake. We're not going to stop- *gunshot*

transcript.speaker: Theatre Tech
transcript.text: Shit! I think they're dead for real!

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Tomorrow is opening night. They can't be dead! Wake up, you idiots!

transcript.speaker: Theatre Tech
transcript.text: Someone replaced the prop gun! Hurry, get a doctor!

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: God damn it! All this work for nothing. *sigh* Well, they're better dead than incompetent.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 01
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Okay folks, we've finally got the results back from the consumer surveys! These ones were to gauge attitudes towards the Abraxodyne Chemical brand.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: We did good, but the board thinks we can do better. They've asked for a full rebranding campaign that focuses on cementing a "family-friendly" image.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: I want us all to put our heads together on this one and come up with some standout ideas. Don't hold back - think big, think bold!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: What about a new mascot? I-I'm thinking an anthropomorphic bubble named "Squeaky" who teaches kids good hygiene and traditional values.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: A what? No, Martin, get it together, for Pete's sake!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How about a commercial? We have the brand recognition and the budget to make something memorable. Lots of the big brands are doing it!

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: A commercial... I like it. We'll need a catchy slogan to go with it too, of course. Something to really sell the "wholesome" angle.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Say no more, say no more, I have got it! "We're soft on fabrics, but hard on Communism!" Not bad, eh? Tell me that's not our pièce de résistance.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Ugh, Martin...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How about we pick something that showcases our values?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Oh, I've got one. "Abraxodyne Chemical: For families who put clean living first."

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: That's perfect, they'll eat that "family first" baloney right up. Nice work Janice.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: All right, good work everybody. Now that's out of the way, let's discuss next quarter's recruitment strategies.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 02
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Our Marketing, P.R. and R&D departments have all been hard at work this quarter crafting our new employee instructional video.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: As requested, we've covered the major areas of concern that have been "problematic" in recent years. So, let's see what you think. Roll the tape.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Welcome, employee. Whether this is your first time donning the Abraxodyne Chemical overalls or the hundredth, this training video is for you!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: By following these simple steps and adhering to our new mandatory safety protocols, you'll be keeping yourself, and the company, out of harm's way.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Employees are expected to take full, personal responsibility for their own actions and for the safety of their team. Remember: safety is no accident!

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Deviation from our chemical handling procedures can have serious consequences; for you, and for the lab.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: *Scream*

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Oops! That's gotta sting. Remember folks, follow the safety procedures outlined in the employee handbook or face the consequences.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Our patented cleaning formula should be tough on grime, not tough on you. Report to a supervisor immediately if you encounter any infractions.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Here at Abraxodyne Chemical, we like to keep things spotless. But, did you know that cleanliness starts with what you say?

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: That's right. Gossip and rumors leave a nasty stain on you and the company. Best to steer clear of the grapevine and avoid the unwanted repercussions.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: When you signed your contract with us, you joined something bigger than yourself. Bigger than detergent. You joined a family.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: And as family, we ask only for the loyalty, commitment, and trust that we've invested into you. Please read your contracts for more details.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: So don't forget, the success of Abraxodyne Chemical lies with you. Stick to these guidelines and we'll all shine!

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 03
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: *Sigh*

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: Something on your mind, Ms. Amrita?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: No, no. Just another lousy meeting where I'm asked to achieve the impossible.

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: That so? Was it as bad as the one last week?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Hah! Worse, in fact. You don't know the half of it Moses.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: You know, sometimes I wonder how we keep getting into these screw-ups, especially after Pittsburgh. I'm always the one left to pick up the pieces.

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: You're a hard worker, Ms. Amrita. Why, I always see you running around here, busy as a one-legged man in a butt-kicking contest!

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: Dealing with the bumps in the road ain't easy, but I'm sure the fine folks here appreciate your efforts.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I really wish I believed you, but sometimes I feel like I'm one bad P.R. statement away from being thrown under the bus.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I've got to start looking into ways to protect myself a bit more... We've all got to cover our backs right?

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 04
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Here you go, ma'am, you can call the number on the back to find more details about Abraxodyne's newest-

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Terry... Terry!

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: What? I'm with a customer right now. Apologies, ma'am, that flyer should have all the info you need. C'mon man, you're distracting me!

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Some guy was just asking me the weirdest questions!

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Yeah, so? People are meant to come and ask us questions, that's why we're here.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Here we are sir, let us know if you'd like any more information.

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Yeah, but this guy was crazy. Get a load of this: He was asking me questions about all the "incidents" the company's had in the last few years and-

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: For the love of God, Ronny! Tell me you didn't give him any details, you're gonna get us both fired!

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Relax, will ya? I'm not an idiot. I remember what they told us in the briefing.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: There we go, ma'am. Come by the booth again, if you have questions.

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Anyways, I tell him to get bent 'cause I'm not gonna accidentally spill the beans to some undercover reporter looking for a scoop.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Oh great, so now we're gonna get written up for insulting the public!

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: Take it easy will ya? I did it all professional-like! He told me that he was with the military and that they're interested in our product's potential.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Interested? Interested how?

transcript.speaker: Ronny
transcript.text: I'm not sure. But, it smells like a bonus if we can take it up the chain.

transcript.speaker: Terry
transcript.text: Yeah... Yeah, maybe you're right. Okay, well what are we waiting for? Let's go find him!

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 05
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Come on Martin, you're one good idea away from getting that promotion, I can feel it!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: The others might laugh at me now, but they won't once I'm in charge, that's for sure.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: I just need something that will grab the board's attention, something that will really blow their socks off...

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Ooo! What about a special edition of Abraxo called "Atomic Sparkle" with trace elements of Uranium. "Your clothes will come out glowing... literally!"

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: No, that will never get through the safety tests! Definitely not after our last whoopsie with radioactive ingredients.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Perhaps we take a different approach? How about an actual soap opera named "Suds Galore"? Where the laundry is clean but the drama is anything but!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: We could even have a talking washing machine voiced by a celebrity to plug our latest products and deal bonanzas.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: No... Far too whimsical, and may give children nightmares.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: I've got it! A line of air fresheners dedicated to American presidents.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: We could have Teddy Roosevelt Tang: Raw, musky, slightly peppery. Smells like gunpowder and moustache wax.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Or-or Truman Spice: Sharp, direct, strong. A smell that isn't afraid to make hard decisions or send the Communists packing!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Voila, it's perfect, I've cracked it! If the board doesn't like this one, I'll eat my hat!

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 06
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: I've told you before, I don't feel comfortable getting in front of any cameras until we've had a proper review of our lab safety requirements!

transcript.speaker: Sheila
transcript.text: And that's been duly noted, Julius. We appreciate you bringing it to our attention, again. Your concern for your fellow lab techs is commendable.

transcript.speaker: Sheila
transcript.text: However, the board has stated several times that they want our lead researcher to be present in this new commercial to add credibility.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: If the board wants credibility then they need to put their money where their mouth is, and start listening to our concerns.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Not spending the budget on flashy commercials instead of the proper safety equipment I've had on the docket for over six months!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Your equipment requests have been received and are currently being reviewed by our finance team for validity.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Validity? My guys are burning through a respirator a day with the old kits! We need stronger equipment if you want us to work on this type of stuff.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: That's enough, Julius. Or do you need reminding of the confidentiality agreement you signed?

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: We need you in the new advertisement, simple as that. Anyhow, you're obligated to perform certain public appearances. Check your contract.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It won't be too strenuous Julius. You'll be fully prepared beforehand and I'll personally see to it that you get your equipment. How does that sound?

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Fine! I'll give you one afternoon, but no more. Someone needs to be supervising the lab techs, given the situation.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Well, I'm glad that's finally sorted. Why the sudden need for stronger respirators though? Our standard equipment has served us fine for years, no?

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: Probably best to leave those details to the experts for now. Thanks for your help today, Amrita. I'll send you the shooting schedule for the ad soon.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 07
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Janitor 1
transcript.text: I mean, how do they expect us to work in these conditions?

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: You said it, pal. Complete joke, if you ask me.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Just a little louder, come on...

transcript.speaker: Janitor 1
transcript.text: It's bad enough that they won't give us any of the new hazmat suits, but not replacing clearly broken equipment?

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: It's downright dangerous if you ask me. And with the wages we're earning, it's hardly worth the risk.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Ugh, I can barely hear them. Maybe it was a mistake hiding in here.

transcript.speaker: Janitor 1
transcript.text: Jake's the third person working this shift who's gone off sick in a month. Now don't tell me that's a coincidence, 'cause I ain't stupid!

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: Hey, at least you weren't the one who inherited his mop. Look at this thing - what was he mopping up with it? Lava?

transcript.speaker: Janitor 2
transcript.text: You can't use that mangled piece of crap. You'd be better off using a wad of paper towels at this rate. Let me grab my spare from the store cupboard.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Oh shi-

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 08
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Hmm, note to self: Check with R&D boys about investigating an edible detergent. A tasty snack that delights the mind and cleans the stomach!

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Oh, it's you...

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Ah, Kerry, hello! I was just looking for you actually. I have another brilliant idea; I think you're going to really like this one.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: What is it this time, Martin?

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: I call it "shower-in-a-can": It's an aerosol spray that eliminates the need for bathing. Convenient for the modern go-getter!

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Yeah, okay, that's great and all, but listen - I have some actual work for you to do. We have a new... product that we need a company codename for.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Ah excellent, I'm quite a wunderkind at that sort of thing. So, what's the new product? I'll be able to whip up a name for you, tout de suite.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Don't worry about what it is, that's classified information. Just make sure it sounds appealing and, uh... clean. Have it on my desk by five.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Right, think Martin, you can do this. Needs to be something fresh, something invigorating. "Spring Clean"? No, too obvious.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Nature... purity; something delicate-sounding that won't overstay its welcome, like a polite dinner guest. Meadow-something, perhaps?

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: "Meadow Glade"? Hm, no-no, not quite. "Meadow Whisper" maybe? No, too sultry. Ah, what about "Meadow Breeze"!

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: Yes, that's it! "Meadow Breeze"! Gentle, yet exciting. Fragrant, yet sophisticated. It screams business but with a delightful je ne sais quoi.

transcript.speaker: Martin
transcript.text: God, I'm good! Note to self: Ask Kerry for a raise.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 09
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: All right everybody, quiet on set please. Roll sound, roll camera. Take 1. And... action!

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Here at Abraxodyne Chemical, we're pioneering the latest and greatest in cleaning products, engineered to brighten your whites and your day... We-

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Cut, CUT! Listen buddy, I know you're probably used to being down in the lab all day and whatnot, but I'm gonna need a little bit more verve, okay?

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: It's hard to be enthusiastic when you're making me read this drivel! Whoever wrote this should spend a hot minute in my lab, then-

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: Okay folks, let's take five and give the "talent" time to blow off some... steam.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Julius, I know this might feel like baloney to you, but we're just trying to go for the most family-friendly vibe we can.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Family-friendly? Amrita, I know you're in charge of the P.R. here, but I didn't think you'd fall for that line yourself!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I-

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: All right, back to positions everybody. Let's take it from the second scene. And here we go!

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: Don't forget to collect your "Abraxo-bucks", found in all eligible Abraxodyne products, for your chance to win a year's supply of premium detergent.

transcript.speaker: Julius
transcript.text: For all your cleaning needs, think Abraxodyne Chemical: For families who put clean living first... Really? Is that what we're going with?

transcript.speaker: Director
transcript.text: CUT!

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 10
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I'm recording this to say, that enough is enough. This... This is getting out of hand now and somebody has to do... something.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It started out with keeping receipts in case the board ever tried to pin one of their screw-ups on me. Just so I had a bit of leverage... Anything.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: But every stone I've unturned, the rot goes deeper and deeper. The more I look, the more I find...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Isn't it my job to know the ugly stuff; so I can shield the brand and help us focus on what really helps people?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Whatever we're doing now, it goes a hell of a lot deeper than the circles I'm part of.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: And this "Meadow Breeze" project I've seen referenced in new data entries... I can't tell exactly what it is, but I do not like the look of it.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I think... I think I need to keep going. I wish I could put this genie back in the bottle and turn a blind eye but, this has all gone too far now

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Somebody's got to hold them to account. And if not me, then who?

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 11
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: How did we get to this stage in the first place, Kerry? I thought we agreed to can this idea after the failure of the first round of testing?

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: We did, but, we were very close, so I encouraged the boys to keep working on an improved formula in their down time.

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: This is unacceptable. Even entertaining the idea of developing this "Meadow Breeze" weapon flies in the face of what this company stands for.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: I hear your concerns, I do, but think of it this way: If we get this right, then Abraxodyne Chemical will be helping protect our troops oversees.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: This stuff is so strong, it could be used as a deterrent against the Commies! Who knows, it might even prevent a war. Now that's patriotic!

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Patriotic? What malarkey! Have you lost your mind? We're a family company, Kerry, remember? That's just not how we do things here.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: I reckoned some of you might not be on board yet, so I took the liberty of compiling the projected revenue from the military contract.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: Mother of God...

transcript.speaker: Wilbur
transcript.text: Well, when you put it that way... Perhaps it wouldn't hurt for the company to get with the times a bit more.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: Yeah, and I suppose we do have a national duty to protect our boys in uniform, after all. It'll be great for morale and market share. *chuckle*

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 12
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I know, ma, but I don't really have a choice right now.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I never thought I'd get promoted out of a secretary position in the first place. I can't mess this up!

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: It's 'cause of this new "genius" contest idea that Tony came up with. Y'know the "Abraxo-bucks" one?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: It wouldn't have been so bad if they'd done the cost projections before committing to it, but now they've realized they can't have "so many winners".

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Now I've got to sort through the distribution data and make sure it's "statistically unlikely" for anyone to actually collect enough of these tickets.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I can't demand that, ma.*Sigh* I'm just going to have to keep staying late until it's done. I'm too afraid to make a fuss about it.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: I know, I know you're right. Anyways, can you put Mikey's dinner in the oven and put the kids to bed for me please? Love you.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: *Sigh*

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Hey, Janice.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Oh, hey Amrita, didn't see you back there! Don't mind what I was saying to my mom, she just worries is all. Everything's fine!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How about you take off and go spend some time with those kids, huh? Tell Tony he can talk to me if he's got a problem with it.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Oh, Amrita, are you sure? I don't want to get you in any trouble. I could really use the sleep though...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It's fine, get out of here, go get some rest. Don't worry, I'll lock up around here after you're gone.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 13
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: For the love of God, I am getting sick of this! It is ridiculous! Every damn thing we say ends up getting leaked to the press somehow!

transcript.speaker: Harold
transcript.text: How are we even meant to have these meetings if there's no guarantee they won't end up in the hands of reporters?

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: All right, Harold, let's keep calm. Indiscretion has caused enough problems already. We just need to tighten up our flow of information, that's all.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: We're lucky that this reporter was caught and dealt with before anything could be published and our brand permanently damaged.

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: Even so, everything points to this being an inside job! How else would they have heard about project Meadow Breeze?

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: That is true. How about this then: If the mole is in this room, come forward, and we can smooth this all out. Right here, right now.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: No? Well, it was worth a try. So be it, tomorrow we'll begin upscaling our internal investigations and, if needed, we won't hesitate to-

transcript.speaker: Kerry
transcript.text: What was that?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Sorry, I, uh... dropped my handbag.

transcript.speaker: Tony
transcript.text: As I was saying, we will do whatever is needed to get to the bottom of this.

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 14
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: This tape is being recorded for my own protection, as well as everyone else's. They're getting close, but I can't stop now.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: It's taken months and several near-misses, but I think I've collected enough evidence to finally hold these bastards to account.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I don't even know who I should show this stuff to - a lawyer? The police? Hell, even the press?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: The important thing is this: project "Meadow Breeze" is not a cleaning product. It's some kind of awful, deadly weapon, and I can prove it.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How it can decimate crops, ecosystems, hell even metal! It's all here in these reports. God only knows what its long term impact on human beings is!

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How did I not realize all of this sooner? Julius was practically spelling it out to me all along. I've been so stupid...

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I'll admit, I've had a part to play in our cover ups over the years, but not this. Never this.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I don't have much time. The board are tying up loose ends and it won't be long before they notice things going missing. I need to get out, and soon.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: All that's left is to listen to these few extra tapes I swiped from the security room. Here goes:

transcript.speaker: Moses
transcript.text: Dealing with the bumps in the road ain't easy, but I'm sure the fine folks here appreciate your efforts.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: I've got to start looking into ways to protect myself a bit more... We've all got to cover our backs, right?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Wait, but that's back when I was talking to... How did they get their hands on my copy? Oh God, oh God! I need to-

items.name: Abraxodyne Tape 15
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Hi, Janice! Come in, take a seat.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: How's everything going? Is the "Abraxo-bucks" initiative making good progress?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: It's going swell, thanks. But I actually had something else I wanted to talk to you about.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Oh. Well I'm always happy to talk things through. What's on your mind?

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: You remember that problem the board had with the "flow of information"? From what I hear, they're getting mighty close to solving it.

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Huh. Well I'm glad to hear that things are-

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: And if I was someone involved in that situation whatsoever, I would sure start thinking about moving on. Sooner rather than later.

transcript.speaker: Janice
transcript.text: Alrighty, well, I've gotta skedaddle now. It was really nice chatting with you again Amrita. Take care, won't you?

transcript.speaker: Amrita
transcript.text: Oh God...

items.name: A Lead at Last
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: Dr. G... I hope this message finds you well. I'm closing in on my target, a big man called Little Rob.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: They say he lives somewhere in the mountains. In some kind of hideout.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: You might wonder who 'they' are... I'm talking about people in the know. Squatters, prospectors, gold diggers. They say they've had run ins with the target.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I met them in a shack in the hills, up near a golf course that's seen better days. But I wasn't there for the greens...

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: We met up and made merry. Don't judge me! You're a merrymaker yourself, you know. They said they could take me to Rob.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I decided to follow. Dangerous, I know, but you have to take some risks if you're gonna get the big score. That's just how it is in this business.

transcript.speaker: Jack Hunter
transcript.text: I'll see you on the other side. Hunter out.

entries.title: Please Read, From Shelley
entries.text:
This is Shelley. I wanted to make sure I left this someplace where you'd see it, Calvin.

I'm leaving Lewisburg. It's gotten too dangerous here, and there's people I'm caring for now that need my protection. 

If you've come back, you'll know where to find me: where Mom and Dad said we'd always live someday.

And if this is a "Sheepsquatch Hunter" reading this and listening to the tapes I left, well... I hope it's providing enough clues to pick up my brother's trail. I want to stay here until I've solved this, but... Alright, that's enough. 

Goodbye, Lewisburg.

entries.text:
February 20, 2070
Hunters: Me, Ray, Scoot
Location: Farmland, Rt. 63

Rumor: Sheep disappearing. Exploring hypothesis that Sheepsquatch eats sheep. This one is Scoot's idea.

--

Findings: I told the guys this was a stupid lead. I'd bet money that Scoot is a cannibal before the Sheepsquatch is! Turns out it was just the neighbor stealing the sheep... obviously.

April 2, 2071
Hunters: Me, Ray, Scoot
Location: Point Pleasant, Trails

--

Rumor: Strange tracks found on trails near Point Pleasant. Provided by a fellow Cryptid hunter from the area.

--

Findings: I had high hopes here, but we couldn't find any tracks.

entries.text:
March 25, 2071
Hunters: Just me
Location: Uncanny Caverns, hills

Rumor: Strange white animal spotted in the area

--

Findings: I knew it, I knew it, I knew it! I just barely caught a glimpse: a beautiful white blur, long horns. It was on four legs-- surprising, but why haven't I considered that? It's real! It's really real! I need to tell Scoot and Ray.

entries.title: Not Real
entries.text:
October 20, 2071

Stop it. It's been months.
It's not real. Why do I have to keep reminding myself? 
What is wrong with me?

entries.menu: Research - SECURITY CODE REQUIRED › Sheepsquatch, 2070 - 2072
entries.title: Still Not Real
entries.text:
July 2, 2072

I have to stop. It's not real. I have to tell the guys I can't do this anymore. It's not real. I can't keep doing this to myself. It's not real. I have to study, I can't let this control my life.

It is not real.

Report: A "creature" spotted by a witness wandering around the hills near Uncanny Caverns. Witness reported this to the police station directly. Police statement claims the witness was visibly intoxicated-- likely a teen getting drunk behind the old sign again.

--

Comments: I've had some good "luck" with Uncanny Caverns in the past, but this didn't go as well as I had hoped. Need to look for places with more reliable witnesses.

[Unintelligible Laughter]

[SCOOT] I've had the same haircut since grade school!
[RAY] Exactly!
[Unintelligible, Laughter]
[RAY] Okay, okay, but down to business. Have you guys read about that "lumbering hairy beast" seen up by Grafton?
[SCOOT] Already debunked by that guy over in Point Pleasant. Was just an old mine cart filled with dirty laundry.
[RAY] Crud. Why's that guy looking into a Sheepsquatch sighting? Doesn't he have a "Mothman" to track down?
[SCOOT] Maybe he finally decided to hunt for a REAL Cryptid.
[RAY] Must be. I don't have anything else. Cal, anything turn up on your end?
[CAL] No, I've... been... studying. Like, for-school-studying.
[SCOOT] You what?
[Unintelligible Laughter]
[CAL] I'm serious! I need... I need to focus more. It's important I get into VTU. I...
[Error: too quiet, unable to dictate]
[RAY] Alright, alright, meeting adjourned. See you guys next month!
[SYSTEM] Dictation stopped
====

=================================================
[System] Roll call: Scott "Scoot" Conroy, Calvin "Cal" van Lowe, Ray Gary
====
[RAY] Okay, well... Let's get started on the, uh, final meeting of the Truth Seekers... for a while.
[CAL] I guess I'll make a statement for the record. I will be beginning my first semester at Vault-Tec University in about a month, so I won't have time for cryptid hunting for a few years.
[RAY] Congratulations again, Cal.
[Error: too quiet, unable to dictate]
[RAY] Well, uh, unfortunately I don't have much to report. There was a sighting last week over by Uncanny Caverns, but... turned out to just be an albino bear, so... Cal, anything?
[CAL] Sorry, no.
[RAY] Alright. Scoot?
[SCOOT] No.
[RAY] Meeting adjourned, then.
[SYSTEM] Dictation stopped
====

[System] Now beginning "Truth Seekers" meeting for September 23rd, 2077. This meeting will be auto-dictated for records.
=================================================
[System] Roll call: Calvin "Cal" van Lowe, Ray Gary
====
[RAY] Okay then, let's get started. It's good to have you back, Cal, even if it's just for today. I'm sorry the other members couldn't make it, some have to travel pretty far these days.
[CAL] Oh, no problem... It's been so long, I'm just glad we could make the time. Still no word from Scoot?
[RAY] No, he hasn't been around in months, he doesn't show up to these anymore. I'm just barely able to keep in touch with him these days.
[CAL] Ah... That's... too bad.
[RAY] Yeah.
[CAL] So, I wanted to just talk a bit, see if you and the other members maybe have heard anything lately... Strange sightings, things wandering around the woods... The, uh, usual.
[RAY] Not really. Just some random police reports of people thinking they saw something late at night-- but we pick up that kind of thing at least once or twice a month. Never leads to anything interesting.
[CAL] I see.
[RAY] And ever since I've been in the chair, it's... been harder for me to get around myself, so... It's...
[CAL] Oh! Oh... I'm sorry, Ray, I didn't mean to...
[RAY] It's fine. I've gotten used to it, been a few years, but it's made personal investigations harder. I mostly just try to make these meetings to pass knowledge on to the new guys.
[CAL] Yeah...
[Error: too quiet, unable to dictate]
[CAL] Well, I really ought to be going, I'm just in town for work and...
[RAY] Be well, Cal... I mean it. I see that look in your eyes.... Be well.
[CAL] Yeah, of course, I... Yes. I will.
[SYSTEM] Dictation stopped
====

items.name: Wanted: Sheepsquatch
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: Hello. I assume you're listening to me now because you followed the poster. Well, I'm Shelley van Lowe and I'm looking for my brother.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: Let me spoil the surprise now: my brother wasn't eaten by a damn Sheepsquatch, or at least, I doubt that's the case.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: But I think Calvin's obsession with proving it exists may have more than a little to do with his disappearance.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: Calvin is... not right. Never been. When he suddenly showed up in town after years of being away, I knew there was something strange going on.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: Next thing I know, he's vanished. All his belongings still here, him: gone. But it doesn't feel right, he didn't just move out again.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: I contacted the police about trying to find him, but the war broke out and... well, I'm sure you know how it all went.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: So, I'll get to the point: I'm leaving Lewisburg, I don't have a choice. But, I can't just forget Calvin.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: If you think you can help, then please... Head up to the office on the third floor. See if you can pick up his trail.

transcript.speaker: Shelley van Lowe
transcript.text: If Calvin is still out there, he needs to know I'm looking for him. And if he's not... well, I think that's something I need to know, too.

items.name: Last Words
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: I don't have much... longer. Had I known... I never would have... but it's too late now, isn't it... But maybe I can help...

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: You... listening to this... whoever you are... you can't undo the virus... but...

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: You can upload your likeness into a white list in the software... then you at least, could live in the city...

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: You just need to get to... my office... there's a scanner... attached to the... the...

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: <Sound of recording device falling to the floor>

items.name: Operation Free Watoga Log 322
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: It's done... I broke the transmission sequencer so no one will be able to remotely reconfigure the machines.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: I also corrupted the software on the update terminals throughout the facility. The only machine capable of creating updates is now in my office.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: I've locked my terminal and wrote a little "fix" to the building's badge access software to prevent any badge other than my own from accessing my office.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: They won't be able to get help from anyone else. Only I will hold the means to their salvation!

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: Soon they'll come down from their ivory towers and come begging me to make it stop.

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: And when they do, I'll make each and every one of them fill out MY "Resident Application Fitness Report."

transcript.speaker: Saboteur
transcript.text: And then I'll deny every last one of them. We'll see how they like it. Being judged. Being locked out in the cold.

items.name: Mission Briefing
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Svetlana
transcript.text: Your mission, should you choose to accept it, is to kill Protectron.

transcript.speaker: Svetlana
transcript.text: That is all. We expect that every man will do his duty. Good luck.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Allegheny
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Allegheny.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: A mental asylum as a last stand against the Scorched. Brave, crazy, and crazy-brave, the Army way...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: At least, I'm pretty sure the Brotherhood had former US Army members judging by the security systems.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: If only they had survived. What I wouldn't give to have a few of America's finest watching my back right now.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: As it is, I'll have to find out how they were planning to combat the Scorched on my own. Once I can figure out a way through these doors...

items.name: Overseer's Log - Camp Venture
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Camp Venture.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Just who was this Brotherhood of Steel? Survivalists? Former Army personnel? They took their training and their call signs seriously, that's for certain.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Organized, efficient, access to hardware. You'd think they'd be ruling West Virginia by now, but they're gone.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: If they're following military logic, then they'll have a fortified headquarters somewhere. And a leader. Someone who knew what they were planning.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Firehouse
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Charleston Fire Department.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Automation used to define life in West Virginia, now it's the only thing left.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: These training programs that the Responders have set up; how many survivors were running through these?

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: It takes a certain calling to voluntarily run into the middle of a fire. Rescue people. Looks like they kept up that spirit even as the dangers changed.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: They must have fought the Scorched up close more than anyone. I need to find out what they knew.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Fort Defiance
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Fort Defiance.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The more I travel this godforsaken "Wasteland," the more I realize what truly destroyed West Virginia.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: And what destroyed any chance the survivors had of... actually surviving. Mistrust.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: All these divergent groups... Responders, Brotherhood of Steel, whatever.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Separately, they had everything necessary to beat the odds. Brains, brawn, and bravado to spare.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: And what did they do? Close ranks. Get paranoid. Refuse to work with one another.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: And it cost them all their lives.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: People of Vault 76, if you're listening... DO NOT fall into the same trap.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: You find each other. You work with each other. Only TOGETHER will you win.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: This is your Overseer. And I'm begging you, please...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Save our country.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Free States
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Free States Bunker.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Sam Blackwell and Raleigh Clay. Those damn traitors and their secessionists turned their backs on America to form their "Free States."

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Concrete bunkers. You'd never get that past a Vault-Tec Radiation Proofing inspection, that's for sure.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Sounds like they let go of their paranoia long enough to seek out help from the other survivors.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Just have to hack this terminal. See what they left behind in there, and what they wanted to do.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Grafton
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Grafton.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The "mayor" of Grafton used to be the automated assistant, and it's gone completely mad. Still trying to run the town. Even holds elections for itself.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: We built these machines to do things without us... and they have. It might be useful if I played along.

items.name: Overseer's Log - McClintock
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Camp McClintock.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: *phew* Maybe I'm going crazy, but it was nice to put on the uniform and play pretend with a bunch of robot drill sergeants.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I actually think I learned a thing or two about marksmanship.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I wonder, now that I'm in the Army, is my official title "Overseer Private" or "Private Overseer"? *laughs*

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Time to see if I can fool a few automated identification systems.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Mountainside
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: *cough* Overseer's log... Somewhere in the mountains...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: *labored breathing* Ooohhhh... Not good, not good, not good.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Just-just trying not... Trying to focus. But the pain is unreal. So bad... Want to do this now while I can... I'm... I'm afraid I might... pass out.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Was attacked... Some kind of... I think it was wearing a gas mask... a heavy coat... But-but not human... Not human...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: No stimpaks left. Funny joke in here about... practicing what you preach... This is... this is... the Overseer. Signing off. Hopefully not for the last time...

items.name: Overseer's Log - Site Alpha
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's Log. Missile Silo Alpha.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: No one's here. Not even any military survivors. That might be for the best. I don't think Vault-Tec asserting jurisdiction over the nukes would've gone over well.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: But, that also means I'm locked out. Access is restricted to the highest ranking officers. It's not going to be easy to fool.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: If we can't secure these sites... My god... the automated factory in the silo... Just how many nukes can it make?

items.name: Overseer's Log - Site Bravo
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's Log. Missile Silo Bravo.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The security systems are still operational, just like at site Alpha. My guess is that site Charlie will be the same story, but I need to be sure.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Still have no idea how I'm going to get the military credentials to gain access.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: My hope, my fear, is that some other group of survivors tried to figure this out as well. We just have to keep looking.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Site Charlie
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's Log. Missile Silo Charlie.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I've now verified that all three missile silos still have fully operational security.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: No way inside, yet, but I'll scour all of Appalachia if I have to.

items.name: Overseer's Log - Top of the World

location.text: Found near Top of the World.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's log. Top of the World.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: There's someone in control of this old ski resort, and if I ever find her, I'm going wash her mouth out with the first thing vaguely resembling soap I can get my hands on. *exasperated grunt of disgust*

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Selfish. That's the word. Maybe that's why she's alone. Maybe that's why she's survived. But the only way she'll tell me what she knows is if I help her first.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: All the good people I've learned about who've died, and it's the sociopath who still gets to live...

items.name: Overseer's Journal, Entry 1

location.text: Found at Vault-Tec Ag Research Center.

items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's... let's call these personal journals. Not an official log. Just... something for me.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The Agricultural Center. One of my first posts with Vault-Tec. I was so excited because I used to come to this same farm when I was a kid.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I remember one year... at the Autumn Festival. Me running through the corn maze. Going every which way. Mom and dad yelling after me to slow down. Ha! Wasn't going to happen.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I guess I was always hitting life fast. Couldn't just be a Pioneer Scout, I had to make troupe leader. Couldn't just be a good student, I had to have straight A's.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: God, I miss those early days. Just... being a kid. The three of us. Our simple life. Our simple house. I wonder if it's still standing...

items.name: Overseer's Journal, Entry 2
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Hi mom. Hi dad. I'm home. I'm sorry it's been so long. I... I couldn't get away.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I know neither of you is around to hear this. But I miss you. I miss watching dad grade papers on the living room table. I miss the three of us huddled around the radio, listening to "The Silver Shroud."

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Dad, you were right about what living underground would really be like. Twenty-five years locked in with the same people was a... challenge.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: But watching them pair up, get married, have children... I think I got to know a little bit of what you and mom were always telling me.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Well, since I'm doing this whole trip down memory lane, maybe a walk over to the old high school is in order...

items.name: Overseer's Journal, Entry 3
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's personal journal.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I was in my junior year when I got the news that mom died. Mining accident. Everyone in West Virginia has a story like that in the family. You just... you never think it's going to be you.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Dad was in pieces. I started living in the library more than before, and I was already there most days to begin with.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: And Evan... god... Evan. Mom had introduced us just a few months before. Graduated a year ahead of me, went right to work in the mines. So handsome. And those arms. What West Virginia girl could resist all that?

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I can't believe he stuck with me. After the funeral, I didn't want anyone around, but there he was. Showing up in the library after his shift with a lunchbox for us to share. Every day.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: When the career fair came, and I met the people from Vault-Tec, it was like a light turned on. Protecting families, protecting their future, protecting... America.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The first thing I did when I got the acceptance letter to Vault-Tec University was head over to mom's grave with dad. He was happy that I was staying in West Virginia. So was I.

items.name: Overseer's Journal, Entry 4
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's personal journal.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Four years of living, learning, and breathing Vault-Tec. Graduating with honors in the Overseer track. Dad was so proud. He came out even though he was already so sick.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I must have impressed the right people, because I was offered the next available Overseer slot. I had just graduated! It was supposed to take years. Maybe they knew the War was inevitable.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: When I learned that 76 was going to be built, I was so excited I jumped right out of my chair and did a little dance around the living room. Appalachia would be safe, no matter what happened.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Evan chose that moment to propose, that lughead. He knew I wouldn't say no after hearing the news. He knew me better than anyone...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Dad died a few months after Evan and I moved in together. He really wanted to walk me down the aisle. Well, I didn't really get to walk down there, either, so... *cough as tears well up, then sigh*

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I think it's time I went home. I owe Evan that much.

items.name: Overseer's Journal, Entry 5
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's personal journal.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Vault 76 was built to take the best and brightest, but... that wasn't what all the Vaults were for.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The Societal Preservation Program. I wasn't supposed to know about it, but when I found out...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Evan wanted me to tell the press, but... I didn't.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Yes, experimenting on Vault residents was ethically wrong, but the goal of finding the most suitable people to repopulate, to understand humanity pushed to the extremes, what if that was the only way for us to survive?

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: We can't save everyone. That's what they always told us. And I thought... I still think... they were right.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Vault-Tec found out that I knew. I thought I was going to be fired, or arrested, but instead they confided in me. Vault 76 was going to be a control Vault. No experiment.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I was so relieved, but... they told me I was going to be assigned to Vault 101, in Washington DC. I had to leave West Virginia... my people... behind.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I couldn't let them do that. No matter what it took.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I'm so sorry, Evan. I wish I could say I would've made another choice. That I would've picked dying in this house together when the bombs fell.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I never stopped thinking about you, and I'm not giving up until I find out what happened. If you're not here, then there's only one other place you'd want to be. The mines.

items.name: Overseer's Journal, Entry 6
items.lead: A holotape lying in the world — it can also come from a quest.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Overseer's... Overseer's personal journal...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I found him. Evan. He's down there, just like I thought he'd be. But I... I didn't think he'd be... one of those things. The green lesions on his face...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Oh god... I did this to him. It's all my fault.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: They told me I could have Vault 76, but not... not if I was married. They would've had to give Evan a spousal exemption and give him space in the Vault.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: But... there was someone more qualified. A civil engineer, someone with the skills to help rebuild. He was a distant cousin of a Vault-Tec executive and almost made the cut...

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: 76 was for the best and brightest, and Evan didn't qualify. Deep down, I knew they were right.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: So I broke off the engagement. I... sacrificed him. For the Vault. For Appalachia.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: I know what I have to do, but I... I just can't. I love him. I already killed him once, I can't do it again.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: Please, I gave 76 everything. You were all so brilliant. The first few years were hard, but we learned to trust each other. You learned to trust me. I was young... So young... Younger than most of you. But you accepted me as your Overseer.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: So I need you to do this for me. Let Evan rest. He didn't deserve any of this.

transcript.speaker: The Overseer
transcript.text: The Scorched. Eliminating this plague. It's not just about survival now. It's personal. We have to secure the nukes. Wipe this disease off the map.

items.name: Protocol Adonais #1
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Screeching metal, crunching) (Screams)

transcript.speaker: Sheepsquatch Imposter
transcript.text: Baa...

transcript.speaker: Sheepsquatch Imposter
transcript.text: (Mechanical foot steps fading away)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (gasp) (cough) What... Ugh...

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (struggle)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Dragging along the ground)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (struggle) al... most...

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Container unlocks) (Fumbling with supplies)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Stimpak injection) (Sigh)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: Ack! ... Ah... (wet cough)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: This is... Calvin... van... Lowe (cough) Initiate... proto-- (rasp) Initiate Protocol.. Ado... nais...

items.name: Protocol Adonais #2
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Gasped breathing, coming to a rest)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: ... Will yet restore me to the vital air... Death feeds on my mute voice, and laughs at our despair...

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Pained laughter, coughing)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Loud rumbles in the distance, sirens)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: The leprous corpse, touched by this spirit tender exhales itself ... in flowers of gentle breath...

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: Like incarnations of the stars... when splendor is changed to fragrance... they illumine death.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (Coughing, rumbling intensifying)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: ... and... mock the merry worm that wake beneath! (coughing)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: Nought we know, dies. Shall that alone which knows be as a sword consumed before the sheath by sightless lightning? (rumbling)

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: The intense atom glows a moment... then is quenched in a most cold repose!

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (coughing, intense rumbling)

items.name: Protocol Adonais #3
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Oh shit, it's really you.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: (rasp) Yeah... Hi... Ray.

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: We tried looking for you, we all knew you weren't... But, ya know, things... happened.

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: ... I'm really happy you're all right.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: If you can call this... (cough) all right... I guess... Listen, Ray. Laura, she's (cough)...

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Stop. I appreciate what you're saying, but stop. She's coming back, man.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: No, I mean, I--

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Enough, Cal. It's good to see you. There's extra supplies in the living room. I haven't heard any break-ins, so they should still be there.

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Take what you need... And get out of here. Appalachia, I mean. These hills, they... It...

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: I know...

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: No, I mean... it was real, Cal. It... did this to me.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: I... know.

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Do me a favor? Grab me a bottle of the good stuff from downstairs before you go? I'd get it myself, but...

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: One step (cough) ahead of you...

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: You're the best, Cal... Take care of yourself, okay?

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: You can... come with me... you know?

transcript.speaker: Ray Gary
transcript.text: Any minute, Cal. She'll be back any minute.

transcript.speaker: Pained Voice
transcript.text: ... Good bye, Ray.

items.name: Protocol Adonais #4
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: (Inhale) (exhale) Ah! Appa-la-chi-yuh!

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Whoa, watch it, smoothskin.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Sorry, just needed a little stretch to go with that delicious, boggy air.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Also, I assure you, the skin under here ain't so smooth, Genie.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Don't call me that-- and yeah, whatever, figure of speech. You seem extra chipper, today.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Oh... That's right. You're a local here. Been a spell since you've been home?

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Oh, more than a spell, my trigger-happy undead friend.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: I swear to god, Aries--

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: This step is the first time my feet hath graced these gentle grounds in my decades long absence.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: You're not listening... Okay, Aries, I'm moving ahead.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Your wayward son returns, you slumbering beast of mists and mystery!

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Re-sculpted and carved into something new, I retread my old grounds with a fresh gleam in my eye, shining brighter than an atomic flash!

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Oh, brother...

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: ... That reminds me, why now?

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: What?

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: You've been on the Kentucky routes since you started. I thought you enjoyed it there. Why come back now?

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: (Inhale) (exhale) Hmm... Family.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Uh... Look I don't know if you heard about that whole Scorched thing, but, well...

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Fear not. My family is here now.

transcript.speaker: Eugenie
transcript.text: Whatever you say, Aries. Let's go.

items.name: Protocol Adonais #5
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Cat
transcript.text: (meow)

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: What the f-- oh, it's just a cat. When's the last time I've even seen a cat?

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Thought Scoot hated cats... Guess things really have changed, huh.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Clearly, it's... been more than a bit since he's been home. That's, uh, probably not a promising sign...

transcript.speaker: Cat
transcript.text: (meow)

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: ... So why come out here, old boy? ... What's this ... truth ... you were so certain of?

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: (typing)

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: (sigh) Oh, Scoot... ... Hm... Geez, I didn't think he was so...

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Well... Nothing recent. Not sure if that's good or bad news, I--

transcript.speaker: Cat
transcript.text: (meow)

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Holy hell, you little bastards are everywhere. You must be repopulating like rabbits.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Repopulating...

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Could it be... ? .... ....

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: No, no, no, no, no... Stop. No, no, no... Come on. Stop it.

transcript.speaker: Cat
transcript.text: (meow)

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: ... but maybe, right? Maybe?

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: No, dammit, shit. Get it together. I gotta get outta--

transcript.speaker: Cat
transcript.text: (meow)

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Oh shut it, furball!

items.name: Protocol Adonais #6
items.lead: A holotape you are given, not one lying in the world.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Carver. It's Aries. Look, I know we've had some weird... uh... encounters. I mean, even weird by my standards.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: There's something about me-- about us-- that I want to tell you. That you... and your family... deserves to know.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: My name is Calvin van Lowe. I'm the brother of your mom, Shelley. I know she ain't your birth mom, but that still makes you family.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: Take a listen to these tapes, if you need the proof. Show them to your mom, she'll know.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: I'm not planning to up and change my life again. I am who I am now. No going back on that.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: But... I'm hoping, maybe... Maybe someday I can start repairing some bridges. And maybe you can help me with that.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: If... you think that's right. You know Shelley, er, your mom better than I do. Sorry to spring this on ya, kid.

transcript.speaker: Aries
transcript.text: And P.S. - If you call me "Uncle Calvin," I'll leave you in a hole so deep in Big Bend they'll never hear you scream.

entries.title: From Headmistress Rivers
entries.text:
THE ORDER OF MYSTERIES
FROM HEADMISTRESS RIVERS

I never thought I would be a part of something like this. All my life, I was just an actress, playing the part of a hero on the radio. But everything changed after the war. There were so many people in need, you girls most of all. Frederick and I were glad to adopt you, to share what we could. Food, shelter, and training - my old acting turned survival skills.

But this world needs more than survival. It needs heroes. It needs you. And these past few years, you have shown me that, together, as sisters, you can accomplish things that even the Mistress of Mystery could never have imagined.

THE ORDER OF MYSTERIES
MISSION STATEMENT

The Order of Mysteries is a sisterhood dedicated to upholding the virtues exemplified by the Mistress of Mystery: courage, cunning, and compassion. We fight in the shadows to protect ourselves, one another, and the people of Appalachia from any threat to their lives or liberty.

entries.title: The Mistress of Mystery
entries.text:
THE ORDER OF MYSTERIES
THE MISTRESS OF MYSTERY

The Mistress of Mystery is one of the longest-running and most popular superheroes in the Hubris Comics canon. First appearing in Hubris Heroes! #8 (2039), the Mistress of Mystery has been featured in hundreds of comic books, radio broadcasts, and other properties and licenses, including a weekly newspaper strip (2052-57), five novels, and several lines of action figures. In August 2077, it was announced that the Mistress would also have a major role in the upcoming live-action Silver Shroud television show, her first appearance on screen.

Born Claudia Martin, the daughter of American archaeologists, her young life was torn apart when her parents mysteriously vanished while investigating the Lost Pyramid of Amun-Re. Orphaned and alone, she was forced to survive by her wits on the streets of Cairo until she was adopted by a wealthy heiress. On her eighteenth birthday, she came into possession of her parents' effects and set out to learn the truth behind their disappearance, delving into a web of ancient legends, occult societies, and dark intrigue.

The Mistress of Mystery is a confident, quick-thinking, and capable hero. Instead of superhuman or mystical powers, she relies on her skill, training, cunning, stealth, and subterfuge to overcome her foes. Although she often operates alone, she has appeared alongside many of Hubris Comics' other heroes over the course of her career, most notably the Silver Shroud (her longtime friend and former love interest), the Inspector (her partner in the Mysterium! mystery serials), and, most recently, the rest of Hubris' greatest heroes on the team of The Unstoppables!

The Mistress of Mystery has been drawn by over thirty artists, notably Tara Winters, Kelly Donnovan, and Lucille Perkins. The iconic radio voice of the Mistress of Mystery is Shannon Rivers.

entries.title: The Regalia of Mystery
entries.text:
THE ORDER OF MYSTERIES
THE REGALIA OF MYSTERY

In addition to her skills and training, the Mistress of Mystery drew upon an arsenal of powerful tools to aid her in her work.
- The VEIL OF SECRETS shields the Mistress' face, cloaks her identity, and hones her senses. It also protects her from a range of threats, including poison gas, smoke, and fumes.
- The GARB OF MYSTERIES is the Mistress' formal gown. Though it took a variety of styles over the years, the Garb was carefully crafted to provide her with unhindered movement, enhancing her stealth and speed.
- The PHANTOM DEVICE is a tool for infiltration, creating a cloud of disorienting smoke to conceal the Mistress while she makes a daring escape.
- The BLADE OF BASTET is the Mistress' legendary sword, a weapon of heroes handed down through the ages. Capable of piercing any armor or barrier, the Blade is lighter, faster, and stronger than any lesser weapon.
- The VOICE OF SET is the iconic .44 Revolver wielded by the Mistress. Its array of powers included the ability to fire bullets that exploded into noxious smoke, disable electronics, or disrupt magical fields.
- The EYE OF RA was the Mistress' greatest relic, a jeweled brooch that allowed her to draw upon the full extent of her abilities in the most dire of trials.

entries.title: Ranks and Promotions
entries.text:
THE ORDER OF MYSTERIES
RANKS and PROMOTIONS

The Order of Mysteries has the following ranks:
- INITIATES are the newest members of the Order. Initiates work full-time with their mentor to learn basic skills and mission tactics. When they have proven that they are capable of handling missions independently, their mentor will approve their promotion to Novice.
- NOVICES continue to train under their mentor and the Mistress of Novices, working to master the tools and techniques of the Mistress of Mystery. In order to advance to the rank of Seeker, they must complete a series of capstone missions to earn the elements of the Mistress' regalia.
- SEEKERS study advanced combat tactics as they prepare for their final test: a mission worthy of the true Mistress of Mystery. After completing their mission, they may apply to the Headmistress for promotion.
- A MISTRESS OF MYSTERY is a full member of the Order, a master of stealth, infiltration, combat, and tactics, capable of handling herself in any situation.
- The MISTRESS OF NOVICES is the second in command of the Order, responsible for organizing and assigning missions and coordinating training programs.
- The HEADMISTRESS is the leader of the Order of Mystery. The first among equals, she inspires and guides the Order in achieving its goals.

THE ORDER OF MYSTERIES
MISSIONS and MISSION REPORTS

Members of the Order of Mysteries undertake missions commensurate with their skills and experience. Missions may be assigned by a more senior member of the order, or accepted from the Cryptos Mission Board.

INITIATES report to their mentor, who will review and assess their progress, and approve their promotion to the rank of Novice.

NOVICES may accept missions from the Mission Board. Except for the automated missions associated with their regalia, they report to their mentor and the Mistress of Novices.

SEEKERS and MISTRESSES report directly to the Headmistress, or to the Mistress of Novices if the Headmistress is unavailable.

entries.text:
THE ORDER OF MYSTERIES
ABOUT HEADMISTRESS RIVERS
(Shaw & Associates Bio, 2075)

Shannon Rivers (2024-) was born in Beckley, West Virginia.

After an early career in regional and touring theater, Ms. Rivers made her radio debut in 2047's "Invaders from Planet Zed!". She quickly earned a reputation as gifted and versatile actress, starring in numerous radio dramas and serials. In 2051, she began her long-running role as the radio voice of the Mistress of Mystery.

Ms. Rivers is well known for her advocacy of charitable causes, especially issues affecting the economically depressed residents of Appalachia.

In 2053, she married Frederick Rivers, noted inventor and architect. They have a daughter, Olivia.

transcript.speaker: Miguel Caldera
transcript.text: Responder Survivors Volunteer Program: Advanced Training: Camping. By Miguel Caldera -- robot programmer extraordinaire!

transcript.speaker: Miguel Caldera
transcript.text: Part 1: Finding the perfect camping location.

transcript.speaker: Miguel Caldera
transcript.text: Now that the world has changed, it's hard to stay safe. Used to be that camping was safe as houses. *laughs* Well, until there was a strong wind.

transcript.speaker: Miguel Caldera
transcript.text: These days, nothing is really safe. Even in your camp, someone might hurt you. The perfect spot doesn't matter now. It's all about your defenses!

transcript.speaker: Miguel Caldera
transcript.text: You can build near people you trust who will watch your back, or build things that will watch your back for you! No problem! Anyone can do it.

transcript.speaker: Miguel Caldera
transcript.text: Remember, camps are mobile. We're all explorers now, camping in a strange land full of adventure, wonder, and danger. So camp often, and rest a lot.

transcript.speaker: Miguel Caldera
transcript.text: Before the war, I was going to retire and go camping. Now I can do it every day, forever! It's a dream come true! Do what you love, right?

transcript.speaker: Miguel Caldera
transcript.text: Now come to my camp and I can show you some knots and framing techniques. Then I'll direct you on to some helpful supplies! Good luck, Volunteer!
